name: Hanthana to Galaha
note: km = distance along GPX. Site distances scaled by gpx/official length. Low-confidence entries placed by scenery match only.

landmarks.name: Ceylon Tea Museum (trailhead)
landmarks.text: Start of Stage 1, in the former Hantana tea factory. The top floor has a tea shop and tea tasting room.

landmarks.name: Hanthana Sandagiri Maha Seya
landmarks.text: The white Sandagiri Maha Seya on the ridge, seen on the left of the trail in the first kilometre.

landmarks.name: View back over Hanthana & Knuckles
landmarks.text: Looking back at the Hanthana towers, the stupa and the Knuckles range on the horizon.

landmarks.name: W15 Hotel & Hill Country Sport Shooting Club
landmarks.text: Trail passes W15 Hanthana and the shooting club.

landmarks.name: Sugarcane Quarantine Center
landmarks.text: Sugarcane quarantine station of the Sugarcane Research Institute.

landmarks.name: Boulders above the valley
landmarks.text: Granite boulders among the trees with the towered Hanthana peak behind.

landmarks.name: Hanthana tea estate
landmarks.text: Shaded estate roads between tea bushes and tall shade trees; often misty.
landmarks.story: Tea pluckers at work on the slopes, one of the many people we met on the way.

landmarks.name: Side trail to meditation stupa
landmarks.text: Short detour to a secluded meditation stupa.

landmarks.name: Pines & boulders near the top
landmarks.text: Pine stand and boulders on the final climb.

landmarks.name: Highest point & viewpoint
landmarks.text: Top of the stage (~1,067 m): views to Victoria Reservoir and the Knuckles Range.

landmarks.name: Katusu Konda rock faces
landmarks.text: Sheer rock cliffs of the Katusu Konda range above the trail. Look for the trail's painted rock markers.
landmarks.story: Team photo under the Katusu Konda cliffs: Adithya, Sudesh, Dinusha, Theshawa and Sithara.

landmarks.name: Descent views
landmarks.text: Long views over layered hills on the way down.

landmarks.name: Stream crossing the road
landmarks.text: A stream crosses the road here; the stone-lined pool is on the right-hand side.
landmarks.story: Bath time where the stream crosses the road! Everyone cooled off, and Adithya went all in for a full bath.

landmarks.name: Small Hindu kovil
landmarks.text: A small roadside Hindu kovil on the right of the road, with village kids around it.
landmarks.story: We filled our water bottles at the kovil and gave 5 chocolates to the kids at the temple.

landmarks.name: Chocolates for flowers
landmarks.text: More kids along the road, just after the kovil.
landmarks.story: We gave 2 more chocolates to some kids, and they gave us a bouquet of flowers in return.

landmarks.name: Temple of Doom film area
landmarks.text: Dense forest section linked to the filming of Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.

landmarks.name: Pine forest road
landmarks.text: Pine forest near the end of the stage; slippery in rain.

landmarks.name: Galaha town
landmarks.text: Into Galaha: shops, a Hindu kovil and trail arrows on the walls.
landmarks.story: We met a few people along the trail; locals were happy to chat with five hikers.
